coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to audit .gitignore and .nvchecker.toml due to API errors (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), leaving those files unreviewed in that report
learnings: When a model encounters transient API errors (HTTP 400/500) during file review, the audit tool should retry or fall back to another model's results for those specific files rather than marking the entire package inconclusive

The verdict aggregation logic should distinguish between 'model found no issues' and 'model failed to complete review' - a tool error should not override a successful safe verdict from another model on the same files

For simple declarative files like .gitignore and .nvchecker.toml, the audit tool could use lightweight pattern matching as a fallback when LLM API calls fail, since these files rarely contain executable content
